notes:
Template content is static (TEMPLATE_SECTIONS joined by 
 plus trailing 
); see fed_template.fed. tree_after values equal to the template are replaced by "<TEMPLATE>". Config.new always creates <base>/.frankmd-config.lock (mode 600, empty). .fed written atomically via .fed.<hex>.tmp + rename, mode 600. 'appended' = text appended to the chomp-joined original lines (upgrade rewrites lines joined by 
, so CRLF becomes LF). log = Rails.logger lines (info+).
